form.label: AD - Account Changes
form.description: User account creation, deletion, enable/disable, password changes, UAC modifications and attribute changes

input.label: Global Search Filter
input.placeholder: Filter by user, target account, or administrator

div.p: Tracks user account creation, deletion, enable/disable, password changes, UAC modifications, and attribute changes.

search.query:
`DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") ( EventCode IN ( 4720, 4722, 4724, 4725, 4726, 4738, 4765, 4766, 4767, 4781, 4794, 5137, 5139, 5138, 5141 ) OR ( EventCode = 5136 AND (ObjectClass = "user" OR ObjectType = "User") ) ) | search "*$search_filter$*" | eval ObjectDN = coalesce(ObjectDN, TargetObject, ObjectName) | eval TargetUser = mvindex(split(ObjectDN, ","), 0) | eval TargetUser = replace(TargetUser, "CN=", "") | eval TargetUser = if(isnull(TargetUser), Account_Name, TargetUser)
| rex field=Message "(?i)Caller Workstation\s*:\s*(?<ComputerName1>[^,\r\n]+)" | eval AdminUser = SubjectUserName | eval Computer = if( EventCode = 4794, ComputerName1, ComputerName)
| lookup cs_obj_change_eventcodes.csv EventCode OUTPUT change_action as RawAction, signature as DefaultSignature, alert
| eval Action = case( EventCode=4720, "Create", EventCode=4722, "Enable", EventCode=4725, "Disable", EventCode=4726, "Delete", EventCode=4767, "Unlock", EventCode=5138, "Undelete", EventCode=5139, "Move", EventCode=5141, "Delete", EventCode=4723, "Password Change Attempt", EventCode=4724, "Password Reset", EventCode=4794, "DSRM Password Reset", EventCode=4781, "Rename", EventCode=4738, "Modify", EventCode=5136, "Modify", EventCode=5137, "Create", 1=1, RawAction ) | eval Action = if(isnull(Action), "Modify", Action)
| eval EventSignature = DefaultSignature
| rex field=Message "(?i)Old UAC Value\s*:\s*(?<OldUac>\d+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)New UAC Value\s*:\s*(?<NewUac>\d+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)userAccountControl\s*:\s*(?<UacValue>\d+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)AttributeLDAPDisplayName\s*:\s*(?<AttrName>[^,\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)AttributeValue\s*:\s*(?<AttrValue>[^,\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)OldValue\s*:\s*(?<OldVal>[^,\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)NewValue\s*:\s*(?<NewVal>[^,\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)Target User\s+Name\s*:\s*(?<TargetUserMsg>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)Member\s+:\s+CN=(?<MemberCN>[^,]+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)Account Name\s*:\s*(?<AccountNameMsg>[^\r\n]+)"
| rex field=Message "(?i)DN\s*:\s*(?<Target_Account_Name>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)New Account:([\s\S]*?)Account Name:\s*(?<Target_Account_Name1>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?s)Changed Attributes:\s*(?<ChangedAttrsBlock>.*?)(?:\n\s*Additional Information:|$)" | eval ChangedAttrsBlock = replace(ChangedAttrsBlock, "\r", "")
| rex field=Message "(?i)Target Account:([\s\S]*?)Account Name:\s*(?<old_dn>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?i)Source Account:([\s\S]*?)Account Name:\s*(?<new_dn>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "Old DN:\s+(?<old_dn>.*)" | rex field=Message "New DN:\s+(?<new_dn>.*)" | rex field=Message "Old Account Name:\s+(?<old_dn>.*)" | rex field=Message "New Account Name:\s+(?<new_dn>.*)"
| eval changedaccount = case(EventCode=4766, "Target: " . old_dn, EventCode=4765, "Target: " . old_dn . " | Source: " . new_dn, EventCode=5139 OR EventCode=4781, "Old: " . old_dn . " | New: " . new_dn, 1=1, null())
| eval ChangedAttrsBlock = replace(ChangedAttrsBlock, "\r", "")
| rex field=ChangedAttrsBlock max_match=0 "(?m)^\s*(?<ChangedAttrName>[^:\n]+?):\s*(?<ChangedAttrValue>[^\n]*)$" | eval final_Target_Account_Name = coalesce(changedaccount,Target_Account_Name,Target_Account_Name1) | eval ChangedAttrPair = mvzip(ChangedAttrName, ChangedAttrValue, " = ") | eval ChangedAttrPair = mvfilter(NOT match(ChangedAttrPair, "=\s*-\s*$") AND ChangedAttrPair!="") | eval ChangedAttributes = mvjoin(ChangedAttrPair, " | ")
| eval TargetUser = coalesce(TargetUser, TargetUserMsg, AccountNameMsg, MemberCN, Account_Name) | eval TargetUser = if(isnull(TargetUser), "Unknown", TargetUser)
| eval UacValue = coalesce(NewUac, UacValue)
| lookup cs_obj_uac.csv userAccountControl as UacValue OUTPUT uac_details as UAC_Details
| lookup cs_obj_uac.csv userAccountControl as OldUac OUTPUT uac_details as Old_UAC_Details
| eval UacChange = if(isnotnull(OldUac) AND isnotnull(NewUac), "UAC changed from " . OldUac . " (" . coalesce(Old_UAC_Details, "Unknown") . ") to " . NewUac . " (" . coalesce(UAC_Details, "Unknown") . ")", null() )
| eval AttributeChange = if(EventCode=5136 AND isnotnull(AttrName), "Attribute '" . AttrName . "' changed from '" . coalesce(OldVal, OldValue) . "' to '" . coalesce(NewVal, AttrValue) . "'", null() )
| eval SpecificChange = if(EventCode=4723, "Password change attempted for user: " . TargetUser, if(EventCode=4724, "Password reset performed for user: " . TargetUser, if(EventCode=4794, "Directory Services Restore Mode password reset attempted", if(EventCode=4720, "User account created with UAC: " . coalesce(UAC_Details, "Unknown"), if(EventCode=4722, "User account enabled (previously disabled)", if(EventCode=4725, "User account disabled", if(EventCode=4767, "User account unlocked", if(EventCode=4781, "User account renamed", if(EventCode=5138, "User account undeleted from Recycle Bin", if(EventCode=5139, "User account moved from: " . coalesce(OldValue, "Unknown") . " to: " . coalesce(NewValue, "Unknown"), null() ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) )
| eval Changes = coalesce( if(EventSignature!="-" AND EventSignature!="" AND EventSignature!="null", EventSignature, null()), UacChange, AttributeChange, SpecificChange )
| eval Changes = if(isnull(Changes), "User account modified (unknown change)", Changes )
| eval UAC_Details = if(isnull(UAC_Details), "Unknown", UAC_Details)
| eval AdminUser=Subject_Account_Name | eval admin_logonID=Logon_ID | eval Member = coalesce(Member_Account_Name,Account_Name, MemberCN, MemberSID, "Unknown")
| table _time, Computer, AdminUser, Subject_Account_Domain, admin_logonID, final_Target_Account_Name, Action, EventCode, signature, ChangedAttributes
| rename final_Target_Account_Name as "Target User", signature as "Changes" | sort - _time

format.colorPalette: {"Enabled:Normal User Account":#43A047, "Disabled:Normal User Account":#E53935, "Enabled:Normal User Account:Password Does Not Expire":#1E88E5, "Disabled:Normal User Account:Password Does Not Expire":#FB8C00}
